name: pairs-leave-open
title: What pair probabilities leave open
idea: Pair probabilities fix the weighted risk but not the chance that a composite direction is right or that every stated direction is right; those need the joint law.
from: new concept · theory book ch. 11 and 19; postrank vignettes m2 and m3 (information requirements) and inputs-and-producers; picture: a joint-law editor for two units on two criteria (presets together and opposite), where what the pair probabilities fix stays locked while composite and joint quantities move
credit: After the postrank theory book, ch. 11 (four-unit law after ch. 19), and the postrank vignette m3.
caption: Restated synthetic finite laws after the postrank theory book, chapters 11 and 19, and vignettes m2/m3. Within-criterion pair errors determine additive expected risk; composite and joint-event probabilities use the complete stipulated law.
